# Schedule {.unnumbered}

Weekly sessions of 90 minutes. **Before the session** is the home checkpoint to
reach before we meet: chapters of [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc) in
Part I, readings in Part II. Selected
[Exercism](https://exercism.org/tracks/python) exercises will be added along
the way.

## Part I: Fundamentals

| Session | Date | Topic | Before the session |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | *TBA* | What is Python? | Nothing: it's the first session 🎉 Bring a laptop with a web browser. |
| 2 | *TBA* | Environments; variables and strings | Install Python ([Setup](setup.qmd)); <br> [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc): *The Shell*, *String Basics*, *Variables* |
| 3 | *TBA* | Loops and conditions | [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc): *For Loops*, *If Statements* |
| 4 | *TBA* | Lists and string methods | [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc): *Lists* (13 short pages) |
| 5 | *TBA* | Functions and nested structures | [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc): *A Bit More About Strings*, *Nested Loops*, *Functions* |
| 6 | *TBA* | Dictionaries and frequency lists | [futurecoder](https://futurecoder.io/course/#toc): *Boolean Operators*, *Dictionaries*; optional: *Tic Tac Toe Project* |
| 7 | *TBA* | Files, batch processing, Unicode | *Python for Everybody*, [Chapter 7: Files](https://www.py4e.com/html3/07-files) |
